dmm-2019-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Let $a(1),a(2),\dots,a(n),\dots$ be an increasing sequence of positive integers satisfying $a(a(n))=3n$ for every positive integer $n$. Compute $a(2019)$.

dmm-2019-tiebreaker-02.prompt: Consider the function $f(12x-7)=18x^3-5x+1$. Then $f(x)$ can be expressed as $f(x)=ax^3+bx^2+cx+d$ for some real numbers $a,b,c$ and $d$. Find the value of $(a+c)(b+d)$.

dmm-2019-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Let $a,b$ be positive integers such that $\sqrt{5+2\sqrt6}=\sqrt a+\sqrt b$. Find the largest value of the quantity $$X=\cfrac{1}{a+\cfrac{1}{b+\cfrac{1}{a+\cdots}}}.$$
dmm-2019-tiebreaker-03.reviewNote: "positive integers" added to the prompt: the paper says only "real numbers", which allows many pairs; the official solution uses {a,b}={2,3}.
